name: Island Dreams Boat Charters
summary: Kenton's yellow boat charter shop in Key Lento, where treasure is sold.
body: GTA BOOM describes Island Dreams Boat Charters as a yellow shop in Key Lento where Kenton buys treasure at the counter.
Push Square says Kenton's boat, the Huntress, is docked at Island Dreams.

name: Leonida Auto World
summary: The place where Randy can be talked to for hints on his wish-list cars.
body: Push Square says talking to Randy at Leonida Auto World sometimes gives hints about where to find each wish-list car.

name: Sweetbay Inn
summary: An inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri where Push Square found the Bravado Banshee late at night.
body: Push Square found Randy's Bravado Banshee parked outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri at around 3am.

name: Trader's Union
summary: A gated yard on Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn, where the '82 Canis Crawler is stolen for Moses.
body: Push Square places the white '82 Canis Crawler at Trader's Union, Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn, behind a locked gate, with a man repairing the car.

facts.location: Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County

name: Starlet Motel
summary: A motel on US-183 in Port Gellhorn whose reception and kitchen hold two Chapter 2 books.
body: Push Square places the Starlet Motel on US-183, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, with Help Me, Help You, Help Me in reception and Children of Wizard Wang in the kitchen, both to be read before the end of Chapter 2.

name: Grayson Motel
summary: A motel on Rockledge Rd north of Taco Bomb West Kalaga, with a book in reception.
body: Push Square places the Grayson Motel on Rockledge Rd, north of the Taco Bomb West Kalaga in Moreau, Lummox County, with The Cowboy's Prayer Is to Die Young on a table in reception.

name: Sands of Time
summary: An old people's home on the Vinewood Beach strip in Waning Sands.
body: The Big Lead describes Sands of Time as the old people's home near Vinewood Beach in Waning Sands, the large enterable building in the middle of the beach strip, with a meteorite chunk on a downstairs office desk.

name: The Buckingham
summary: A building on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach, across from a No Flusher marking.
body: Push Square places a No Flusher utility marking on the ground on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach, across from The Buckingham.

facts.location: Shore Dr, Ocean Beach, Vice Beach
